Generates fuzzing code from fd_types.json type definitions.

# Purpose
This script reads `fd_types.json` and generates a C header file for fuzzing support. It writes include guards, compiler pragmas, and type-specific `*_generate` functions that fill structs, enums, opaque types, vectors, maps, deques, treaps, and other container fields with random or mutated data. The code uses a set of helper classes such as `PrimitiveMember`, `StructType`, and `EnumType` to map JSON type descriptions into generated C code. Its scope is narrow: it is a code generator for one type schema file and one output header file.
